messages:
maya: Heads up — Gravity Inc (INV-2026-331) called. Invoice shows SPRING_PROMO applied twice for $12.50 each. Can finance confirm and advise next steps?
jon: On it. Can you paste the invoice link?
maya: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-331 — two separate line items:
```
SPRING_PROMO   -$12.50
SPRING_PROMO   -$12.50
```
billing-bot: Auto-detect: potential duplicate promo applied (rule: promo_dupe_check) — flagged for manual review.
ravi: If confirmed duplicate, we should issue a microcredit for $12.50 and correct the invoice. Do we treat this as technical correction or goodwill?
claire: Customer is on startup plan — small credit fine. I can approve credits up to $20. No need to escalate.
jon: For audit trail please run: `/invoice adjust INV-2026-331 credit 12.50 --reason "duplicate promo (SPRING_PROMO)" --source manual-goodwill`
maya: Ran that and got: `Error: manager_approval_required (threshold $10.00)`.
claire: I approve the manual goodwill credit for $12.50. Note: "Customer impacted by double promo application."
jon: Applying final command now...
jon: Command output: `Success: credit created CR-2026-778; invoice balance updated; ledger entries appended.`
billing-bot: CR-2026-778 created; invoice INV-2026-331 updated; audit note appended: "duplicate SPRING_PROMO reversed via manual goodwill credit".
maya: Customer notified by support that a $12.50 credit was applied. Support ticket #SUP-48912 updated. Closing thread. :tada:
